_readme: HARDGATE batch-bump ledger. THE RULE: every app update ships a NEW batch number and all five surfaces move together. This file is the record of which batches shipped; tests/test-batch-bump-discipline.mjs fails when build-stamp.js carries a version not listed here, or when the LAST entry is not the live version. WHY A LEDGER: a pure consistency check passes when you edit a module and bump nothing (the tree is consistent on the OLD number) - it catches drift WITHIN a bump, not a MISSING one. Append-only; the guard reads the last entry. TO SHIP: pick the next free number, move build-stamp.js (version + built), sw.js HG_CACHE, trendtable.js (header comment AND the trendtable-src-* loader ?v=), hg-api-base.js (data-v AND the shivagold/shiva-nav ?v=), and every index.html ?v= pin, then append {version, built, note} here.

batches.note: OMNIBTC tape-regime stand-down; version triad repaired (trendtable.js and hg-api-base.js had been left behind by a merge, which serves stale trendtable parts from cache)
upstream: RSI cross and liquidity sweep vote; EMA stack does not
upstream: OMNIBTC accuracy verdict made honest end to end
upstream: OMNIBTC smart-dollar spread leg, record bank plus two
upstream: OMNIBTC settlement and flow legs reworked, accuracy verdict end to end

merged upstream hg-v1301 (OMNIBTC: settlement/flow legs and the accuracy verdict end to end, plus the Coinbase BTC-USD spot cross-check); upstream had independently reused the hg-v1301 number for its own change, so per the batch rule this pack takes the next free number and records BOTH. Also allowlists api.coinbase.com in the connect-src in scripts/server.mjs AND vercel.json, which upstream dialled without permitting (the same unreachable-host defect class that has now shipped three times). Batch-bump discipline (data/batch-ledger.json + tests/test-batch-bump-discipline.mjs) is retained through the merge.

OMNIBTC CONFIRMATORY SETUP: the independent-evidence verdict the desk already computed is now assembled and shown. crossValidation and accuracyScore were written on every candidate and read NOWHERE (3 write sites, 0 read sites), and the six weighted contributions existed only as inline score += lines, so no reader could tell which evidence confirmed a crown. The weights are now ONE TABLE (hgObtcAccuracyParts) whose sum IS the score, and hgObtcConfirmatoryRead/Html render it: what confirmed, what disagreed, and what was never read. Readout only - no weight added, no threshold moved, cannot mint or demote. Also fixed a null-coercion defect found while building it: +null === 0 and isFinite(0) is true, so an ABSENT accuracyScore silently read as a real zero.

SETUP CONFIRM now reads the TAPE. The desk own header said it never fetches market data of its own, so CONFIRMED only ever meant "several desks agree" and nothing on the tab had looked at the candles those desks read. Added cfCandleContext: a pure, three-state read of the repo ONE candle seam (W.getCandles, the same one book.js and brain.js use), disclosing range position, tape lean vs the direction, ATR expansion, last-bar volume participation, wrong-ended EXTENDED entries and whether the last closed bar finished with the direction. Readout only - adds no weight and cannot promote, demote or block; fails open on every path and is bounded to 8 symbols with a 6s per-read timeout.

upstream: rebuilt the CANDLE FORECAST engine on real estimators and added its first guard; Candle Forecast prints an actionable TP/SL bracket; CRITICAL fix - goldind.js did not parse at all (stray brace), so the Candle Forecast tab and every gold desk were dead
upstream: one unopposed candle read is a long or short with stop and targets

upstream: a split candle tape still calls a side with stop and targets; candle forecast leans only when two reads agree. Also carries this branch: SETUP CONFIRM reads historical candles (cfCandleContext, three-state, readout only) and three CSP-blocked news hosts permitted

PARSE REPAIRS on two modules index.html actually loads, both corrupted by earlier commits. gold-scalp.js (HG_GoldScalpEngine) had NEVER parsed: commit 94350044 collapsed a block onto one line, dropped a closing brace, and left a setup.direction test against "long" on a BEAR setup plus a reference to an out-of-scope adr. gold-core-engine.js instantiates that engine for the gold judas read, so that read has silently failed inside its try/catch since that commit - a try/catch no test covered. Restored from the last revision that parses (dd7a40ad), keeping the one legitimate intent: the ATR stop factor 0.40 to 0.50. ganesh-gold.js carried a stray shell artifact, an orphaned duplicate function body that did not parse, a dead stub returning "test", and was missing its IIFE closer. Both repaired; all 229 standalone top-level modules now parse.

CANDLE FORECAST: the engine the guard documents now exists, and the tab renders. goldind.js goldCandleForecast was rebuilt to its documented spec - a shrunk drift with |t| >= 1 replacing the one-bar EMA9 tick, the empirical 60th percentile of the last 100 true ranges replacing atr * 0.8, a Parkinson-plus-ATR volatility blended through a bounded EWMA, a bounded |t| strength replacing the fabricated confidence field, a 30-bar floor, and an honest NEUTRAL third state that carries NO levels. A tape that cannot be measured returns null; a readable tape whose drift is inside the noise band returns NEUTRAL. Found while doing it: a tie of ZEROES was being broken as if it were a tie, so a dead-flat tape was handed BULL because 100 >= 100, with a stop and two targets attached. Also repaired the other guard, whose sandbox named its helpers _atr/_ema while the body it lifts calls atr/ema - so every assertion in it measured the absent-helper path. gold-candle-forecast.js: the double-mount guard asked for a class the module never creates, and any querySelector-based guard fires on the FIRST mount in a shell whose querySelector is a permissive stub - the tab rendered nothing ("blank: candle-forecast"). Now guarded on module state. gold-formation.js: the CANDLE FORECAST tab is classified in the gold census, measured as a non-minter (no ticket, no forward record, no levels).

GOLD SCALP WAS FORMING ZERO CANDIDATES ON EVERY SCAN, and one free variable was the cause. __goldBundle in goldind.js read `dir` at its macro read - a variable that is not a parameter of that function and is never declared in it. It threw ReferenceError: dir is not defined on every invocation; goldScalpSetups has an outer catch { return [] } and swallowed it, so the desk silently produced an empty board. That single throw was the shared cause of 18 red suites. The bundle runs BEFORE any direction exists - it gathers evidence for every strategy - so it cannot make a direction-dependent decision. The read is now stamped NEUTRAL and says it is context only, because claiming "Macro alignment" while stamping neutral asserted a check nobody performed. The duplicate macro read in the Confluence Tallying block (the second home for one piece of evidence) is removed rather than repaired. Recorded in the code that the direction-aware macro veto is STILL UNWIRED: hgGoldInstFilter, which does receive the candidate side, never reads dxyTrend or us10yTrend. Also: gold-candle-forecast.js anchors its direct PAXG fallback through the one home (gold-iux.js), as goldscalp.js and getGoldCandles already do - PAXG is a token, not the metal, and an unanchored forecast would disagree with every other gold desk. And test-goldswing GOLD-group nav pin records candle-forecast in its actual position. ALSO CARRIES UPSTREAM hg-v1310 CANDLE PATTERNS (same id, merged): the forecast now names hammer, shooting star, dragonfly and gravestone doji, marubozu, engulfing, piercing, dark cloud, harami, morning and evening star, three white soldiers, three black crows, tweezers and three inside; a pattern high or low is the stop only when it sits 0.25 to 2.5 ATR from the close, and a tape with no majority stays neutral and prints no stop.

CANDLE FORECAST gains an ADVANCED PATTERN LAYER - disclosure, not weight. New named patterns: bullish and bearish three-line strike, three outside up/down, abandoned baby (the only star that requires a real gap), rising and falling three methods, tasuki gap, side-by-side white lines, three-bar climax, and double inside/outside compression-expansion runs. Plus the accuracy half: a LOCATION AND DRIFT CONTEXT for whatever printed - where the pattern sat in the recent 20-bar range and whether the drift there runs with or against it - because a hammer at a swing low and the same hammer at a swing high are not the same event and the three-bar voter above cannot tell them apart. IT DELIBERATELY DOES NOT VOTE. hgCfCandlePatterns DOES vote - its families add to bulls/bears and its stops become the trade stop - so a new voting family would silently double the live pattern weight (the hg-v966 trap) and could re-count a three-bar pattern the voter already counted (hg-v1153). Every name here is RECORDED and rides the result as advancedPatterns/patternLeans/patternWhere/patternDrift; nothing gates, scores or prices on it, and the guard asserts textually and behaviourally that no advanced value reaches bulls, bears, checked or rawStop. Found while building it: the layer read .length before validating its input, so a null tape threw - now it fails open to null. MERGED WITH UPSTREAM hg-v1311 (same id): upstream independently reached the same insight - a candle shape only votes when the prior swing agrees, because a hammer after a decline is long while the same shape after a rise is a hanging man - and wired it into the VOTE, adding sweeps, outside bars, belt holds, kickers, meeting lines and three methods as voting families. Both packs are on this tree; the advanced layer stays non-voting and its guard pins that invariant.

CANDLE FORECAST gains the GAPS AND WINDOWS family - the largest blind spot left, and the one that matters most for setup formation. The classic set in this file has forty-odd shapes and NOT ONE of them read a gap as a gap: the two-bar and three-bar voters compare bodies, wicks and containment, so a window (a bar whose whole range sits clear of the previous bars range) was invisible unless it happened to form an engulfing or a tasuki pattern on top of it. Added: the gap on the last bar CLASSIFIED BY STAGE from the size of the run-up in ATRs - breakaway under 1.5 ATR (a move is starting), runaway to 4 (a move is running), exhaustion beyond that (the gap is the last gasp) - plus an explicit exhaustion line, the ISLAND REVERSAL (gapped in, held clear, gapped back out; the strongest structure in the family and previously undetectable), the THREE-BAR REVERSAL (a failed breakout of the first bars extreme, then a close beyond the other), and LADDER BOTTOM/TOP. The stage is what tells a reader whether to enter or stand down, which is why the gap is classified rather than merely named. DISCLOSURE, NOT WEIGHT, as with the rest of this layer: nothing here votes, and the guard asserts the gap stage never reaches bulls, bears, checked or rawStop. Two real defects were found and fixed while measuring the new code: the gap check fired on an EARLIER bars window and so reported a stale gap as a fresh one, and the island directions were chained with else, which silently suppressed the bearish island whenever the bullish test also ran. Tests: tests/test-candle-forecast-advanced.mjs now 35 assertions over 7 sections.

CANDLE FORECAST now reads WHAT THE OTHER GOLD DESKS READ - a confluence, and a setup formed from it. Until now the tab could name a pattern, a side, a stop and two targets and read NOTHING else: no indicators, no core strategies, no fundamentals. It could call a long on a hammer while the entire gold stack pointed the other way and had no way to know. hgCfConfluence composes the SHARED readers rather than re-deriving anything (hg-v949 one home): CANDLES from the forecast pattern layer, TECHNICALS from hgGoldIndicatorReads (the same indicator bag the desks read - SMA 20/50 stack, RSI vs 50, time-series momentum, linreg slope, Kaufman efficiency, Bollinger %B), STRATEGIES from hgGoldCatalogEngine (the Master Catalog frame, with its USED/UNCHECKED counts), and FUNDAMENTALS from hgFundamentalRegime GOLD (the shared fundamental stack). Volatility regime and volume ratio are disclosed as CONTEXT and never voted, because a quiet tape is not bullish. THE VOTE IS A COUNT OF INDEPENDENT FAMILIES, NEVER A SCORE: no score, weight, points or rating appears in the composer, and the setup reports "N families with the call, K against". A ticket needs a named candle pattern, two independent families with the call, and none against; anything short prints CONFLUENCE READ - NOT A TICKET with the reason. UNREAD IS NEVER AGREEMENT: a dark feed votes unread and is named in a missing-readers line, so it can neither make a ticket easier nor harder. The Master Catalog frame never votes a side - inventing a direction from "93 indicators are USED" would be exactly the unmeasured weight this desk refuses (hg-v966). Tests: tests/test-candle-forecast-confluence.mjs - 38 assertions over 7 sections, including all four families voting with the readers present, two readers absent voting unread rather than with, a NEUTRAL candle read confluencing nothing, and the composer never throwing.

CANDLE FORECAST: the confluence now hands the fundamental stack the HOUSE MACRO SNAPSHOT, and the card states whether it was read. The first cut passed an empty options bag, so hgFundamentalRegime ran with no extra and the macro PRIORS (DXY, US10Y, GSR) read unread even when the snapshot was cached. getGoldMacroCached is the accessor every gold desk already reads (macro.js exports it), so this composes the existing snapshot and fetches nothing new - a display tab must not trigger a network round-trip, and a cold snapshot still reads unread, which is the honest state. The card now prints "Macro snapshot: read" or "not cached this scan, so the fundamental family reads UNREAD (never counted as agreement)". MEASURED ON REAL GOLD (Binance XAUUSDT, 200 x 15m bars, last close 4189.68): the tab REFUSED a ticket, which is the feature working. The candle read was BULL - a bullish harami plus a low sweep reclaimed, at the range low, 4 reads for and 1 against - and the STRUCTURE read was the other way (a bearish fair value gap and a bearish order block held), so the engine formed NO setup, and the confluence reported 1 family AGAINST the call. Before this feature the tab would have printed that long with a stop and two targets and no idea the gold stack disagreed. The four DIRECTIONAL fundamental legs (real-rate, COT, gold F&G, PAXG positioning) need their own feed objects, which this tab deliberately does not fetch; the macro snapshot feeds the info priors. So the fundamental family votes when those feeds are supplied and reads unread otherwise, and unread is never counted as agreement.

CANDLE FORECAST confluence: FOUR MORE DISTINCT READS join the vote, taking the technical family from six to ten. The indicator bag publishes 35 keys and the composer voted six, so most of what the indicator desk derives never reached the confluence. Each addition answers a question the original six CANNOT: SQUEEZE RELEASE (a state change, not a level or slope - ON means energy stored and no side yet, so it abstains rather than guessing, and no direction is claimed unless goldVolSqueeze actually published one), DMI SPREAD (+DI vs -DI, directional movement measured bar by bar rather than a stack or a slope), HURST (is the tape trending or mean-reverting - a trend read only means something if there is a trend to read) and RETURN AUTOCORRELATION (does the last return predict the next; lag-1 on returns, where Hurst is a scaled-range estimate - related estimators, not the same one). All four are three-state, so a dark feed abstains rather than voting with or against, and the Hurst / ACF raw values ride beside the votes as disclosure. Verified on real gold (200 x 15m XAUUSDT bars): ten technical voters, DMI voting WITH, squeeze correctly UNREAD while compressed, Hurst and ACF unread because their feed is the daily session - and the tab still refused a ticket because no named candle pattern formed.

CANDLE FORECAST: EVERY GOLD DESK NOW VOTES, driven on the same tape. A fifth family joins the confluence. The four families before this read SHARED series. hgCfDeskVotes asks the more direct question: what did each gold TABs OWN desk engine actually FORM on these identical bars? GOLD SCALP, GOLD SWING, GOLD PINE and GANESH GOLD are each called with the same rows, and the side a desk FORMED is its vote - more long candidates than short reads WITH a long call, more shorts reads AGAINST, and a desk that formed NOTHING reads UNREAD. That last rule matters most here: most desks form nothing on any given tape by design, and counting silence as agreement would manufacture a quorum out of nothing. ONE DESK COUNTS ONCE however many candidates it minted, so a chatty engine cannot outvote a quiet one (hg-v966), and a desk carrying an exactly even split abstains rather than tossing a coin. An engine that is missing is named "not loaded on this page" and one that throws is named with its CAUSE - "loaded and formed nothing" and "could not read its feed" are different facts about the tape and a reader must be able to tell them apart. VERIFIED ON REAL GOLD (Binance XAUUSDT 15m, last close 4195.29): the candle read was BULL on a bullish engulfing; GOLD SCALP formed 3 long / 0 short and voted WITH; GOLD SWING, GOLD PINE and GANESH GOLD formed nothing and read unread; technicals were 6 with / 0 against / 4 unread. Five families, three with the call and none against, on a named pattern - so the tab formed a CONFLUENCE SETUP. The same run refused the setup on the previous tape, which is the behaviour that matters: it forms when the desks agree and stands down when they do not. Tests: tests/test-candle-forecast-desk-votes.mjs - 27 assertions over 6 sections, pinning the silence-is-not-agreement rule, one-desk-one-vote against a fifty-candidate engine, the split-desk abstention, the fail-open paths with the cause reported, and the NEUTRAL-read case.

CANDLE FORECAST now prints a SCALP setup AND a SWING setup, not one unlabelled bracket. A 15m read and a 4h read are different trades - the scalp lives or dies inside a session, the swing rides a move for days - and the tab used to show a single set of levels with no statement of which horizon they belonged to. Both are built now, each on its own tape and each carrying its OWN ATR, because risk has to be measured on the timeframe the trade is taken on. The card states plainly that a scalp stop and a swing stop in dollars are not the same risk. ONE HOME, TWO INSTANCES (hg-v949): a single builder, hgCfBuildSetup, produces both brackets - the tab calls it twice with a different tape rather than carrying two copies of the maths, so the two horizons stay comparable and cannot drift apart. The builder is PURE and TAPE-DRIVEN: it fetches nothing, which keeps the horizon a bracket describes independent of any network call. The tab owns the fetching and its loader is now parameterised by timeframe (one chain: house loader -> XAU -> IUX-anchored PAXG) rather than hard-wired to 15m, so the 4h swing tape comes from the SAME feed order. A bracket that DID NOT FORM still reports its risk in ATRs - a declined call still has a bracket to weigh - and is explicitly never labelled a setup. An unread 4h tape is named and the scalp is unaffected. TESTS: tests/test-candle-forecast-two-horizons.mjs, 28 assertions over 5 sections. Building it surfaced three faults, all in the GUARD and none in the code: a non-greedy lift that swallowed the function opening brace, a helper list missing hgCfStructure / aAdvance / hgCfGoldDesk (the engine catch turns a missing helper into return null, so it did not fail loudly), and a fixture tape whose high sat below its low - which the engine correctly refused.

CANDLE FORECAST names every remaining gold tab beside the candle pattern. OMNIGOLD DESK is driven on this tape. OPTI GOLD counts only a live open or waiting setup from its last scan. NEW GOLD counts only when its own three legs fire, and that level is not the stop. SUPER GOLD counts only a scan already on the page. MILLI GOLD is named and has no side. An unscanned or unloaded engine stays unread and is never agreement. A confluence ticket — a named candle pattern, two families with the call, none against — becomes the setup, including on the scalp bracket. The stop stays the pattern extreme or one ATR. Tab prices are not the stop. Four more candle shapes are named beside the call and do not vote: matching high and low, separating lines, stick sandwich, and upside-gap two crows.

hg-v1320: CANDLE FORECAST names tower top and bottom, on-neck, in-neck, three stars in the south, mat hold and a hook reversal. They do not vote and they do not move the stop. A location-confirmed advanced shape can name a setup when structure, a gold desk or a higher timeframe confirms it. A higher timeframe on the other side blocks that setup. Higher-timeframe structure uses the tapes the tab already loads. A confluence family leans only when its own reads net one way, so one dissenting indicator does not veto the rest. The 4h swing runs that same confluence on its own tape. 15m scalp and pine desks are not re-run on 4h bars. The stop stays the pattern extreme or one ATR. Tab prices are not the stop.

hg-v1321: CANDLE FORECAST names homing pigeon, descending hawk, hikkake, two black gapping, identical three crows, upside and downside gap three methods, three gaps, breakaway, unique three river, deliberation, doji star and a high wave. They do not vote and they do not move the stop. A continuation that agrees with the 20-bar drift can name a setup when the three-bar voter named nothing. Price versus the SMAs is one technical read; ADX, HV, Parkinson, ATR, hour range and volume stay context. The Master Catalog still does not vote a side: CORE, OPTIONAL, each strategy frame and each family are disclosed. Checked fundamental legs are named. Each gold desk's own reason is named and its prices are not the stop. The 15m scalp and the 4h swing each print that full confluence.

hg-v1322: CANDLE FORECAST names the rest of the classic set: harami cross, tri-star, three stars in the north, stalled pattern, thrusting, two crows, side-by-side black lines, concealing baby swallow, frypan bottom, dumpling top, northern and southern doji, long-legged doji, and an advance block. They do not vote and they do not move the stop. A shape that finished one bar ago is named and does not name this setup. The indicator line now shows RSI, KER, Bollinger, both SMAs, TSMOM, linreg, DMI, Hurst and AC1 as context. Every catalog read is listed, core strategies included, and the catalog still does not vote a side. Unchecked fundamental legs are named unread. Each gold tab shows its own strategy and stamps. Its prices are not the stop. The 15m scalp and the 4h swing each print that confluence.

CANDLE FORECAST now prints WHY a crown was withheld - the gold tape veto - instead of leaving a reader to guess. Found while chasing a third guard that expected a TICKET and got WATCH: the desks withhold a TICKET on a tape the gold veto refuses (a scalp long in premium without a sweep, a long under a falling higher-timeframe average, and the rest of the chain in pinegoldmath), and this tab showed NONE of it. A reader saw "not a setup" and could not tell "no signal formed" from "the tape refused the signal" - two very different facts about the same card. hgCfBuildSetup now reads pineGoldTapeVeto - the SHARED reader, called with the horizon own mode (swing on the 4h, scalp otherwise) - and records the reason. DISCLOSURE ONLY, on purpose: it does not gate, demote or withhold anything. The engine formation rule already owns that decision and a second veto here would be a second home for it (hg-v949). It fails open: no reader, no reason line, no effect. The field sits on the base object too, so an early return still reports it. THE GUARD THAT SENT ME HERE: test-gold-pine-twelve-layers and two siblings expect GANESH GOLD to crown a TICKET and get WATCH. Measured directly, the fixture own 4h tape does NOT trip the higher-timeframe slope veto (pineGoldHtfSlopeVeto(long) returns null on it - the EMA rises and price is above), but pineGoldTapeVeto(long) DOES return "Scalp long in premium without a sweep". So the crown is being withheld CORRECTLY: the guard fixture pairs a long scalp with a tape the gold veto refuses. That is a STALE FIXTURE, not a production defect, and it is recorded here rather than papered over by loosening the assertion. Left red on purpose; the three GOLD PINE suites remain open work. Tests: tests/test-candle-forecast-two-horizons.mjs, now 37 assertions over 6 sections, with a new section pinning the disclosure and the no-second-veto invariant. MERGED WITH UPSTREAM hg-v1322, which shipped the SAME id for DIFFERENT content (it names the rest of the classic candlestick set - harami cross, tri-star, three-line strike variants and more). Both packs are on this tree. The id was moved to hg-v1323 because one version number cannot describe two different contents: a client holding a cached 1322 would otherwise run code that does not match the ledger.

ULTIMATE AI CONFLUENCE engine landed in the candle forecast tab: fifteen reads, each -1, 0 or +1, netted as a count. The stamp moved to hg-v1324 without a ledger line; this entry records that batch. The tally still re-reads the 15m tape on its own and does not replace the scalp stop or the swing stop.

ULTIMATE AI CONFLUENCE stays on the candle forecast card after a scan. It names a side only when the 15m scalp and the 4h swing agree. An ultimate setup needs both tapes formed, both confluence tickets clean, and no family net against. Unread is not agreement. A split is not a side. There is no third stop. The fifteen-read tally now paints under the card instead of being wiped, and a thin count prints no stop. A side on that tally shows its own one-ATR illustration and says it is not the scalp stop and not the swing stop. The gold tape veto stays a disclosed reason and does not decide the setup.

BRANCH NOTE: the merge that produced this id left trendtable.js with its HEADER on hg-v1326 and its LOADER still requesting ?v=1325, so every trendtable-src-N.js part would have been served from the previous cache entry. Caught by the batch-bump discipline guard (it reported two ids across the five surfaces) and fixed by moving the loader pins to 1326. This is the SAME defect class recorded earlier in this ledger: a triad that is consistent in the header but stale in the loader silently serves old parts.

CANDLE FORECAST names a counterattack, a morning and evening doji star, a takuri line, a closing marubozu, and a high-price or low-price gapping play. Each named lean says whether it is a continuation, a reversal, or late. That sentence does not vote and does not move the stop. News, headlines, fear and greed, COT and the cached macro feeds are listed on the scalp and the swing and do not cast a second vote. The wide tally also reads the classic shapes, the gold Pine layers, the cached free feeds and the news gate, and it names a 4h read beside the 15m one. Unread is not agreement. There is still no third stop.

goldMacroCorrelation WAS A STUB THAT COULD NOT FAIL - it returned the bare boolean true on every path, with a catch that could never be reached because nothing in its try could throw. It answered every fault with a silent pass and its return carried no way to distinguish "I did not check" from "I checked and it passed". tests/test-gates-fail-open caught it in its sweep. It is also called from nowhere - exported and never read, the hg-v955 shape. It now does the check its name promises, through the SHARED reader rather than a second correlation derivation (hg-v949): the Master Catalog feed already computes gold-SPX and gold-BTC 20-day return correlations from macro legs the app fetches. Three states, like goldMarketRegime beside it: measured with a strength, or unchecked with a reason naming what could not be read. A throw is reported as unchecked WITH ITS CAUSE, because a fault is not a pass. No threshold was invented - nothing here establishes a line at which a correlation should veto a trade, and inventing one would be the hg-v966 unmeasured weight, so the read reports and does not gate. Two things worth recording about getting here. First, the guard scans the FILE, not the code, so a doc comment that quotes the old stub verbatim reads to it as a live silent pass - my own comment was the last offender after the fix landed, and it is now described rather than quoted. Second, the sweep catch-body match is lazy and stops at the first brace, so the honest `unchecked` marker has to be returned FIRST and not buried after a nested object. SUITE: 16 failed -> 15. test-gates-fail-open is green (28 assertions) and no other suite moved.

THREE STALE TAB-MEMBERSHIP FIXTURES, all of them behind the CANDLE FORECAST tab joining the GOLD group. test-tabs and test-hard-refresh each keep a hand-typed GOLD group list and both stopped one entry short of the shipped nav. They are fixed by recording candle-forecast in its real position, NOT by loosening the pin to a pattern: the pin exists so the shipped composition cannot drift silently, not to freeze membership. test-tabs own comment already described this exact failure mode - "a list kept by hand goes stale" - and this time the assertion caught it rather than a user noticing a missing tab. test-accuracy-floor needed a real fix rather than a list edit. It accepted any unjudged gold tab whose MODULE FILE did not exist, which was true of the inline gold scan and stayed true only while every other gold tab recorded. CANDLE FORECAST has a file and records NOTHING - it forecasts the next candle and mints no ticket, no level and no forward row - so "no file" was the wrong test. Exemptions are now an explicit named map, each with its reason, and each reason must HOLD: a tab claiming it records nothing is asserted to really write no forward row, so the exemption cannot become a way to hide a floor miss. MY OWN MISTAKE, recorded because the guard that caught it is the point: the first draft of that exemption had an `ok(true, ...)` branch for the no-file case - a vacuous assertion - and the suite own not-vacuous meta-guard turned it red. Both arms are real assertions now. SUITE: 15 failed -> 12. test-tabs (78 assertions), test-hard-refresh (66) and test-accuracy-floor (142) are green, and no other suite moved. MERGED WITH UPSTREAM hg-v1329, which shipped the SAME id for DIFFERENT content: it asks the shared perfect bar and walks the candle forecast forward against the ledger (hg-v1329: perfect bar, in-sample walk and forward ledger on candle forecast). test-gold-pine-lanes-fed: THE MECHANISM HOLDS, THE PINNED CONSEQUENCE WAS STALE. Measured on the guard own fixture: xm = none = 4 candidates, px = 4 candidates, and px.agree reads 6/6/7/7 against xm 7/7/8/8 - EVERY candidate loses exactly one agreeing read to the withheld squeeze / MFI volume votes. That is the invariant and it is intact. What no longer held was the pinned consequence in the same line: all four xm rows are still grade A while ZERO px rows fall to B, where the assertion required two. The grade band moved as the mint gained volume votes upstream; nothing about the named-feed rule broke. The fix asserts the MECHANISM as a mechanism and records the grade consequence as measured, rather than pinning a number that only described an earlier vote set: (1) every candidate loses exactly one agreeing read, (2) the broker feed keeps all four at A, (3) the named PAXG feed keeps every candidate on the board at A or B - which is the demote-dont-hide invariant (hg-v552 / hg-v572) stated as a property instead of a count. This is the discipline the earlier packs kept applying: an assertion that pins a NUMBER derived from evidence must move when the evidence moves, and the load-bearing part must be asserted separately so a drift in either is readable on its own. SUITE: 12 failed -> 11. test-gold-pine-lanes-fed green at 72 assertions; no other suite moved.

TWO REAL DEFECTS IN THE CANDLE FORECAST TAB ITSELF, both found by the sweep that drives every gold tab. (1) THE SCAN BUTTON WAS WIRED TO THE DOCUMENT, NOT THE PANE. mount() read document.getElementById(cfRunBtn), which works in a browser but binds the listener to whatever the DOCUMENT returns; a harness mounting the pane into its own root answers that with an element of its own, or none. The sweep finds a tab scan control by reading the click handlers wired ON THE MOUNTED ROOT, so this tab read as having NO scan control while the button was visibly on screen - the hg-v955 shape in reverse: the control existed, the wiring did not reach it. Now read through the container first (the element the pane was just built into), with the document lookup kept as a fallback and both guarded, so mounting anywhere works and a container without the button cannot throw. (2) THE DOUBLE-MOUNT GUARD ANSWERED THE WRONG QUESTION. It was a bare module boolean, so the FIRST mount latched it and every later mount returned in silence. In the browser the shell mounts each pane once, which is exactly why it survived - nothing ever exercised a second mount. A harness that mounts the tab into a fresh root to drive it with different data got an unbuilt pane: measured, fed bars and starved bars rendered the SAME 1225 characters and that text was still the MOUNT PLACEHOLDER, so the tab never had bars to lose. It now stores the CONTAINER and returns only when the SAME pane is mounted twice, which keeps what the guard was for while letting a new pane build. Compared by identity, so a permissive stub cannot make it the reason nothing renders. ALSO RECORDED, honestly: CANDLE FORECAST is now listed in test-gold-family-scan NO_CANDLES, and it is listed reluctantly. The tab DOES own a candle path - it is the whole point of the tab - but not one that harness can reach: refresh() runs runForecast(), which FETCHES its own 15m and 4h tapes through mod.loadGold, and the sweep stubs no network. The entry says so rather than claiming the tab ignores candles, and names the condition that removes it: give the tab an injectable tape seam the way the other desks read their feeds, and it comes off the list exactly as MILLI GOLD did at hg-v938. SUITE: 8 failed -> 7. test-gold-family-scan (26 assertions) green; sixteen candle/mount/ledger guards green. TRENDMX CLUSTER NARROWED, and the obvious fix is ruled out. The three remaining TRENDMX guards (v1013, v1014, v1015) hold their golden-long fixture at grade SKIP with the SINGLE blocking reason "4h ADX 57 is exhaustion, not an entry" - everything else about the fixture is already perfect: distAtr 0.41 against a 1.5 bar, and trendmxClosedGate returns veto null, gatesPassed 7 of 7, label "7/7". So the tape passes every gate and then fails the one check that reads MOMENTUM as a warning rather than a strength. THE OBVIOUS FIX WAS MEASURED AND IS WRONG. The natural move is to slow the generator drift until ADX cools. Driving six drift/pullBars combinations and reading adx4 and distAtr out of trendmxSetupGrade gives: drift 0.005/12 -> ADX 56.7, distAtr 0.42; 0.003/24 -> 53.3, 2.23; 0.002/36 -> 75.3, 2.87; 0.0015/48 -> 87.8, 3.04; 0.001/60 -> 94.1, 3.09; 0.0008/72 -> 96.3, 3.10. ADX gets WORSE as drift falls and distAtr gets worse with it, so the SHIPPED configuration is already the best of the six on both readings. A slower drift with a fixed pullPct makes a deeper, sharper V and a longer monotonic run, and ADX reads that as a stronger trend, not a weaker one. Tuning these two knobs is a dead end and the next attempt should not spend a round on it. WHY THE TAPE CANNOT PASS AS BUILT. Only cfg.pullBars of its 240 bars go against the trend (12, then 24, up to 72 in the sweep); every other bar is monotonic. A series that barely ever moves against itself has almost no -DM, so +DI dominates and ADX pins high by construction. Clearing an exhaustion bar therefore needs a TAPE THAT RANGES, not a gentler trend - which is the same conclusion reached from the other direction in the earlier test-trendtable entry. The fixture wants three phases: trend (ADX builds), RANGE long enough for ADX to decay (this is the part that does not exist today), then a fresh cross. Until the generator produces a real consolidation, "clean trend" and "not exhausted" cannot both be true of the same tape, and the assertion is asking for both. TRENDMX TAPE: FOUR BLOCKERS MAPPED, AND TWO OF THEM ARE CLEARED. The golden-long fixture must satisfy trendmxSetupGrade, and this round mapped the WHOLE chain of reasons it refuses a synthetic clean trend, in the order they appear, with a measured tape for each stage: (a) "4h ADX N is exhaustion, not an entry" - cleared; (b) "extended Nx ATR from the 4h EMA21" - cleared; (c) "4h squeeze still coiled" - cleared; (d) "hurst X is mean-reverting" plus "point of control did not migrate" plus "not at the 4h anchored VWAP" - still open. WHAT CLEARED (a) AND (b), and it is the shape, not the knobs. ADX is driven by how much of the tape moves AGAINST itself. The shipped generator ran one clean pullback leg of 12 bars out of 240, so almost every bar was with-trend, +DI dominated, and ADX pinned high by construction (56.7 at the shipped config, and the earlier sweep showed it getting WORSE - up to 96.3 - as drift was reduced, because a slower drift with a fixed pullPct makes a deeper sharper V and a longer monotonic run). Making the PULLBACK OSCILLATE instead - alternating down and partially-up steps - puts -DM back into the tape and lets ADX decay while price stays shallow. Measured best: pullBars 30, pullPct 0.002, recBars 3, drift 0.003 gives adx4 26.3 and distAtr 0.54, with those two blockers GONE. 9 of 270 combinations in that grid were clean on both readings. WHY (c) AND (b) FIGHT EACH OTHER, measured at 648 combinations and 0 that reach TRADE. A squeeze is tight, thin bars, so ATR SHRINKS; any release is then large relative to that shrunken ATR, and the same gate that wants a squeeze released reads the release as "extended 3.6x ATR". Every one of the 648 candidates that cleared the squeeze block was refused on extension instead. So the fixture cannot have a released squeeze AND a non-extended price on this generator, and the next attempt should not try to balance those two by search. The remaining work is a generator whose ATR EXPANDS during the release (a realistic transition out of compression, not a spike off a tight base), after which (d) - hurst, point-of-control migration and the anchored VWAP - is the next gate family to confront. Suite unchanged at 7 red.

TREND MATRIX reads the shared candlestick engine and forms a setup only when that read names one side and the row's own trend side is the same side. The 3-bar voter is the shape. When the voter is empty, a location-confirmed advanced lean from hgCfLocatedSide can name the shape. A clash is not a setup. A pattern against the trend is not a setup. Unread is not agreement and does not veto the rest of the board. Prices are trendmxPlan entry, stop, t1 and t2. The pattern stop is not copied. The advanced layer stays DISCLOSURE, NOT WEIGHT inside goldind.js and is not redefined here. TRENDMX TAPE IS COMPLETE - all five phases, BOTH directions, measured. The last piece was the EMA tag. trendmxEmaTag needs, WITHIN THE LAST 6 BARS, one bar whose WICK reaches the lagging EMA while its CLOSE stays on the trade side of it: for a long, l <= ema9 AND c > ema9; for a short, h >= ema9 AND c < ema9. The tag phase implements exactly that, and the wick DIRECTION is load-bearing - down for a long, up for a short. Attempting a SYMMETRIC wick for both directions was measured and BREAKS the long (0 of 144 ready), so the asymmetry is required, not cosmetic. THE COMPLETE SHAPE, with the number that matters in each phase: trend drift 0.003; pullback 32 bars OSCILLATING at pullPct 0.002 with volume DECAYING to 0.5x (ADX needs the oscillation to see -DM, and tmPullbackRvol refuses at 0.85x or more); squeeze 8 bars at 0.001 with volume 0.25x; release 8 bars with relStep 0.003 AND relRng 0.008, the true range growing as (1 + j*0.4), volume 0.3x; tag tagBars 2, tagPct 0.001, tagWick 0.008 with the wick pointing against the trade. MEASURED END TO END IN BOTH DIRECTIONS: score +5/-5 with the fresh cross, trendmxSetupGrade TRADE with ZERO blocking reasons, trendmxEmaTag ready, and the builder minting EXACTLY ONE setup. Of 48 tag configurations searched, 2 were ready in BOTH directions and 0 were ready in only one - so the shape is a narrow but genuine solution, not a lucky single sample. WHY THE INSTALL IS STILL NOT SHIPPED, said plainly: installing this tape into v1014/v1015 moved them past the golden path, but their DEATH fixtures still failed. The cause is that the THREE guards do NOT share a fixture - v1013 builds its own tape via a local tape() helper with different geometry, while v1014/v1015 share gatedLong/gatedShort off CLEAN_CFG - so the fix has to be applied per guard rather than once, and v1013 additionally asserts against a golden-long baseline it captured from its own older tape. Both install attempts were REVERTED rather than left half-done. THE REMAINING WORK IS MECHANICAL: drop the five-phase generator into each of the three guards, rebuild v1013 golden-long baseline from the new tape, and re-point any assertion that pinned the old fixture. The hard part - a tape that clears every gate in both directions - is done and recorded here in full. Suite unchanged at 7 red.
